family.name: CYCLIC_SHARED_PAYLOAD_POWER_OF_TWO_SUBFAMILY
family.formula: AND_i ((x_i OR z_i OR NOT z_{i+1}) AND (NOT x_i OR z_{i+2} OR NOT z_{i+3})) with z indices cyclic mod m

balanced_tree_carry_boundary_lemma.name: R5_E8_BALANCED_TREE_CARRY_BOUNDARY_LEMMA_V1

claims.result: After the selector-clause pairs form blocks G_1,...,G_m, the first 2^r blocks form a complete balanced subtree while G_m is the unique final unpaired item at every upper round until the root; G_m is therefore carried unchanged as the shallow tail.
The final pair (G_{m-1},G_m) is formed at the first block-tree round; thereafter that tail-pair is the unique final unpaired item at every upper round until the root.
The block-level balanced AND tree is complete and has no carry-tail asymmetry.

proof_sketch: At block level, m=2^r+1 gives 2^(r-1) ordinary pairs plus one carried tail.
After one round the item count is 2^(r-1)+1; induction repeats until the final root merge.
For m=2^r+2, the last two blocks first combine into one tail item, reducing to the previous recurrence with 2^(r-1)+1 items.
For m=2^r every round has an even power-of-two number of items, so no carry occurs.

power_of_two_prefix_target.name: R5_E8_CYCLIC_POWER_OF_TWO_SELECTOR_PREFIX_THEOREM_V1
power_of_two_prefix_target.theorem_goal: There exists fixed alpha>0 and r0 such that for every r>=r0, the frozen exact structural projector on F_{2^r} selects selector variables for at least alpha*2^r relevant steps before any payload elimination destroys the branch-separation invariant.

required_obligations.P1: Exact frozen CNF->AIG compilation for m=2^r has no carry-tail asymmetry.
required_obligations.P2: For each of the first t>=alpha*m relevant steps, the minimum exact projected cost among ALL unresolved variables is attained by a selector x in X, including cone/tie comparison.
required_obligations.P4: No SAT oracle, equivalence oracle, FRAIG, BDD sweeping, semantic rewrite, or hidden existential escape.

first_sharpened_scheduler_theorem.name: R5_E8_ODD_SELECTOR_GREEDY_PREFIX_THEOREM_V1
first_sharpened_scheduler_theorem.claim: For every m=2^r>=4, before selecting any payload variable, the frozen exact greedy projector selects all m/2 odd selector variables.

step0.conclusion: Every selector beats every payload at step0; selector ties are broken by id, hence x1 is selected.

non_authoritative_pattern_note.m32: Additional exploratory probe reported a selector prefix of at least 12, but it is not promoted here without a completed frozen-executor replay receipt.

semantic_compactness_control.identity: For private selector x_i in G_i=(x_i OR A_i) AND (NOT x_i OR B_i), existential elimination gives A_i OR B_i.
semantic_compactness_control.cyclic_payload: A_i and B_i are 2-clauses, so the exact semantic selector projection has a clause of width at most 4.
semantic_compactness_control.interpretation: Any large frozen structural-AIG growth on the selector prefix is representational/syntactic for this grammar, not evidence that the projected Boolean function itself lacks a compact exact representation.

obligations: For arbitrary m=2^r odd-only prefix states, prove kappa_v=0 for relevant unresolved odd selectors and every payload comparator.
Prove there exists unresolved odd selector o such that for every payload z: A_z-A_o >= sigma_z-sigma_o.
When equality holds, prove A_o<A_z; selector IDs already beat payload IDs on tertiary tie.
Do not count full projected DAG size N_t separately; N_t is common and cancels from the exact greedy comparison.
already_closed: STEP_0 selector win for arbitrary r

odd_selector_branch_injectivity.theorem: For m=2^r>=4, any prefix of t distinct odd selector projections, while even selector blocks remain unresolved, preserves at least 2^t distinct nonconstant noncomplement reachable structural branch-root refs under the frozen grammar.

finite_diagnostic_m32.note: Replay evaluates frozen trial keys sequentially and keeps only the winning arena; selector semantics and tie ordering are unchanged. This is diagnostic only.

net_projection_charge.identity: For every currently reachable trial variable v: cost(v)=N+A_v-sigma_v-kappa_v.

payload_backbone_rigidity.theorem: On every odd-selector-only prefix state, every payload z has kappa_z=0 and sigma_z<=s_z+12.
payload_backbone_rigidity.consequence: Shannon backbone cannot give payload an unbounded nonlocal simplification discount; payload savings are bounded by the four local occurrence neighborhoods.

exact_results: Therefore first greedy choice is selector x1
